description: Use whenever a user names a token by ticker or name ("buy BONK"). Tickers are not unique and copycats reuse them; never pick a mint from memory. Finds the real mint for a ticker or name, ranks candidates by verification and liquidity, and warns when copycats share the ticker. Inputs: query: Ticker, name or mint address, e.g. "BONK", "Jupiter", "USDC". Cost: 3 free calls, then $0.001 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/resolve_token.
name: resolve_token
